summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts and adds a currency argument backed by Intl.NumberFormat. invoiceLines now passes a currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still imported and called by cart
findings.problem: This change removes the formatPrice export from src/money.ts. src/cart.ts line 1 still imports formatPrice, and cartTotal calls it on line 8.
findings.consequence: The tsc build fails because src/cart.ts imports a missing export. Without the build, cartTotal throws at runtime and customers cannot see a cart total.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Another option is to keep formatPrice as a wrapper that calls formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now uses Intl.NumberFormat, which adds thousands separators and moves the minus sign before the currency symbol. The repository has no test for formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Nothing catches a regression in the amounts that invoices show to customers.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines. Cover large amounts, negative amounts and a non-USD currency.
